targets.primary: sign of exact full-census shared-reference EOG span change under ideal M release (A&B)
targets.tolerance: same scaled 1e-10 as parent fibre_summary; no tuned thresholds

assay.unit: one noise-free binary measurement of A, B or M at one row-major node; equal costs
assay.candidate_nodes: all row-major candidate nodes; G-occupied nodes are necessarily A=B=M=true and uninformative
assay.adaptive: selection uses compatible candidates and their target labels only; never knows hidden true mask before observing bit
assay.deduplicate: choose site and evaluate target on distinct A/B/M mask triples; preserve original world-label memberships only as bookkeeping

policies.greedy_all: Choose unused informative axis,node maximizing separated pairs of distinct candidate triples having different target direction; ties A<B<M then node ascending; stop when sign identified or no positive separation
policies.greedy_B: same target-aware greedy restricted to B nodes
policies.greedy_A: same target-aware greedy restricted to A nodes
policies.generic_hash: 16 fixed seeds 20261107–20261122; fixed SHA-256 ranking of axis,node without using target labels; choose first still-variable unused site, stop if sign identified or no informative site

evaluation.simulate_truth: all candidate mask triples as truths; query bit from chosen truth only after selection; retain consistent candidates
evaluation.uniform_resolution: every possible truth path must end with one target sign; no weighting by parameter labels
evaluation.denominators: all 129 fibres for A/B/M and initially ambiguous M fibres (8, with 5 opposite signs) separately
evaluation.compare: greedy all, B-only, A-only, 16 generic baselines under same budgets; seed medians/ranges not biological replicates

integrity: site choice independent of hidden truth
full B known ceiling reproduces 126/129 M direction-known prior result
same fixed reference and static release definitions
inference_limit: Finite constructed model worlds, noiseless ideal assays, no frequencies or probabilities, no independent ecological validation or new EOG-WF endpoint; never infer causal biological effect.
